title: Yn chymmyltaght laa er laa
description: Ten mini stories about the environment in everyday life: a foggy Sunday on a farm, a fisherman and warming seas, rebuilding a dam above Sulby, a school science evening, mugwort on Tynwald Day, local food at the market, buses and a twinned town, a plastic-free wedding, a lion at a zoo and Manx words for nature.

lessons.title: Kay er y vagher
lessons.summary: On a foggy Sunday morning the farmer Cathal Fitzgerald near Peel finds a hen missing and the fence broken; the hen is sheltering under the oak in the hollow beside a hare, and Cathal and his willing wife Nuala bring the cattle back and mend the fence before the fog lifts.
lessons.text:
Ta Cathal Fitzgerald ny eirinagh faggys da Pheeil. Ta ollagh echey 'sy vagher mooar, as ta kiarkyn echey ayns thie beg ry-lhiattee rish y thie echey. Dagh moghrey, ta Cathal goll magh dy yeeaghyn er yn ollagh as er ny kiarkyn.

Moghrey Jedoonee, dirree Cathal ec shiaght er y chlag. Va kay ayn. Va'n kay cho trome nagh row Cathal abyl yn magher y akin veih'n thie. “Cha vaik mee rieau kay myr shoh,” dooyrt eh rish e ven, Nuala.

Hie Cathal magh dys thie ny kiarkyn hoshiaght. Va thie ny kiarkyn foshlit, as va un chiark ersooyl. Hie eh sheese dys y lag fo'n thie. Ta billey darragh mooar 'sy lag. Tra ta drogh emshir ayn, ta ny kiarkyn goaill fastee fo'n darragh. As shen y raad va'n chiark: fo'n billey darragh, ayns fastee veih'n kay as veih'n gheay. Va mwaagh ny hoie faggys jee. Tra honnick y mwaagh Cathal, roie eh ersooyl trooid y lag. Ta ram mwaaee cummal 'sy lag shoh, er y fa dy vel y thalloo bog as dy vel faiyr vie ayn. Ghow Cathal y chiark ayns e laueyn as hug eh ee er-ash dys thie ny kiarkyn.

Eisht hie eh dys y vagher. Va'n chleigh er ny brishey ayns un voayl, as va paart jeh'n ollagh er y raad. Haink Nuala magh. V'ee booiagh gobbraghey marish. Ren ad yn ollagh y chur er-ash dys y vagher, as ren ad y chleigh y yannoo kiart lesh fuygh noa.

Mysh nane jeig er y chlag, hie yn kay ersooyl, as haink y ghrian magh. Va'n ollagh 'sy vagher, va ny kiarkyn ayns nyn dhie, as va'n chleigh lajer reesht. Va Cathal booiagh. “Ta Jedoonee mie ain foast,” dooyrt eh. Eisht hie eh as Nuala sheese dys y lag, as v'ad ny soie fo'n darragh rish tammylt. Cha row veg dy kay ayn ny sodjey.

Feyshtyn:
Cre va ayn moghrey Jedoonee?
Va kay trome ayn moghrey Jedoonee.
Raad va'n chiark?
V'ee fo'n billey darragh 'sy lag.
Cre roie ersooyl trooid y lag?
Roie mwaagh ersooyl trooid y lag.
Cre va er ny brishey 'sy vagher?
Va'n chleigh er ny brishey 'sy vagher.
Row Nuala booiagh gobbraghey marish Cathal?
Va. V'ee booiagh gobbraghey marish.

lessons.title: Yn eeasteyr as y frioggan mooar
lessons.summary: Odhran Tierney, a fisherman in Peel in a yellow rubber smock, sails out, sees a huge fish with a tall fin and watches a gull swallow a fish from his box; the harbour guard Bronagh Hennessy calls him back before a storm and explains that warmer seas and melting polar ice bring new fish north.
lessons.text:
Ta Odhran Tierney ny eeasteyr ayns Pheeil. Ta baatey beg echey lesh shiaull gorrym. Dagh moghrey 'sy tourey, ta Odhran goll magh er y cheayn. Ta lheiney rubbyr wuigh echey, er y fa dy vel ushtey as fliaghey er y vaatey dagh laa. Ta'n lheiney rubbyr çheh, as cha nel yn ushtey goll trooid.

Moghrey Jeheiney, hie Odhran magh lesh y gheay 'sy shiaull. Va'n cheayn feer vie, as va'n ghrian sollys. Foddey magh veih'n traie, honnick eh frioggan mooar ard ass yn ushtey. Va'n frioggan doo, as va'n eeast hene cho mooar as y baatey echey. Cha row aggle er Odhran. Ta ny eeastyn mooarey shoh gee eeastyn beggey ayns yn ushtey; cha nel ad gee sleih.

Ghow Odhran eeastyn beggey, as hug eh ad ayns kishtey. Eisht haink ushag vooar vane dys y vaatey. Ghow yn ushag eeast beg ass y kishtey echey, as slug ee eh. “Cha nel shen cair!” dooyrt Odhran, agh va'n ushag er sluggey yn eeast roish my va fys echey.

Ec y traa shen, ren Bronagh Hennessy loayrt rish er y çhellvane. She arreyder ee ec y phurt. Ta'n arreyder jeeaghyn er y cheayn as er ny baatyn dagh laa. “Ta stoyr çheet jiu,” dooyrt yn arreyder. “Tar er-ash nish.” Haink Odhran er-ash dys y phurt lesh y gheay 'sy shiaull.

Er y traie, dinsh Odhran da Bronagh mychione y frioggan mooar. “Ta ram jeu ain nish,” dooyrt ee. “Ta'n faarkey ny s'çheh na v'eh, as ta eeastyn noa çheet veih'n jiass. Ayns ny ardjyn poullagh, ta'n rio lheie. Ta'n rio poullagh ny sloo dagh blein, as ta'n faarkey caghlaa.” Ghow Odhran jeh e lheiney wuigh, as ren eh smooinaghtyn er ny dooyrt ee.

Feyshtyn:
Cre ta Odhran Tierney jannoo?
She eeasteyr eh ayns Pheeil.
Cre'n lheiney t'echey er y vaatey?
Ta lheiney rubbyr wuigh echey.
Cre honnick Odhran ass yn ushtey?
Honnick eh frioggan mooar ard.
Cre ren yn ushag vane?
Ghow ee eeast beg ass y kishtey, as slug ee eh.
Quoi ta Bronagh Hennessy?
She arreyder ee ec y phurt.
Cre ta taghyrt ayns ny ardjyn poullagh?
Ta'n rio lheie ayns ny ardjyn poullagh.

lessons.title: Yn stang ayns y foar
lessons.summary: The engineer Deirdre Nolan explains the reconstruction of the old dam in the gorge above Sulby: the water's pressure on the wall, the pipes linking it to towns kilometres away and the wall being raised higher, while the ecologist Imran Boland studies a non-native plant on the banks before the minister launches the work.
lessons.text:
Ta glion feer ard ayns ny sleityn erskyn Sulby. Ta'n glion shoh ny foar: ta creggyn ard er dagh slyst jeh, as ta awin veg roie trooid y foar. Ayns y foar, ta stang mooar. Va'n stang troggit 'sy vlein 1982. T'eh cummal ushtey son ram jeh sleih yn ellan.

Ta Deirdre Nolan gobbraghey er y stang. Ta'n stang shenn nish, as ta aahroggal mooar çheet. “Ta'n aahroggal shoh doillee,” dooyrt Deirdre. “Ta çhionnid mooar ec yn ushtey er y voalley. Tra ta'n ushtey ard, ta'n çhionnid ny smoo. Ta feme ain y boalley y yannoo ny s'lajer, roish my vees y çhionnid ro vooar.”

Ta'n stang cochianglt rish Rhumsaa as rish Doolish liorish feddanyn mooarey fo'n thalloo. Ta ny feddanyn cochianglt rish thieyn as scoillyn. Ta Rhumsaa ny smoo na hoght kilomeadar veih'n stang, as ta Doolish ny smoo na feed kilomeadar ersooyl. Lurg yn aahroggal, bee'n boalley ny syrjey. “Trog y boalley ny syrjey!” dooyrt yn shirveish. Hrog ad y chied voalley 'sy vlein 1982.

Ta Imran Boland gobbraghey marish Deirdre. T'eh gobbraghey ayns eggoaylleeaght. Ta eggoaylleeaght ronsaghey er ny lossreeyn, ny baaghyn as y thalloo, as er cre'n aght t'ad bentyn rish y cheilley. Ta Imran jeeaghyn er ny lossreeyn mygeayrt y stang. Hooar eh lus neughooghyssagh rish oirr yn ushtey. Haink y lus neughooghyssagh shoh veih çheer elley. T'eh aase dy tappee, as cha nel boayl ny sodjey ec ny lossreeyn elley. “Ta feme ain y lus shoh y ghoaill ersooyl,” dooyrt Imran.

Jeheiney, haink y shirveish dy launshey yn obbyr. Va sleih ayns shen veih Sulby as veih Rhumsaa. Ren y shirveish loayrt mychione yn ushtey as mychione y foar. Eisht ren eh launshey yn aahroggal, as va ny sleih booiagh.

Feyshtyn:
Raad ta'n stang?
Ta'n stang ayns y foar erskyn Sulby.
Cre ta'n ushtey jannoo er y voalley?
Ta çhionnid mooar ec yn ushtey er y voalley.
Cre cha foddey ta Doolish veih'n stang?
Ta Doolish ny smoo na feed kilomeadar ersooyl.
Cre hooar Imran rish oirr yn ushtey?
Hooar eh lus neughooghyssagh.
Cre'n vlein hrog ad y chied voalley?
Hrog ad eh 'sy vlein 1982.
Quoi ren launshey yn aahroggal?
Ren y shirveish launshey yn aahroggal.

lessons.title: Oie sheanse
lessons.summary: At a science evening in a Ramsey school the teacher Alastair Brady shows pupils salt crystals, grains of sand and plastic fibres under a microscope, a see-through jar and a neon light, then talks about a comet flying past the Earth, quantum physics and Einstein's theory of relativity.
lessons.text:
Ec scoill ayns Rhumsaa, va oie sheanse ayn. Haink ny paitçhyn as nyn ayraghyn as moiraghyn dys y scoill ec shiaght er y chlag. Va'n ynseyder, Alastair Brady, ayns y thie sheanse marish ram reddyn.

Hoshiaght, ren Alastair sollan y chur fo'n vynreayrtan. “Jeeagh!” dooyrt eh. “Ta'n sollan jeant jeh crystalyn.” Va dagh crystal ayns cummey kishtey veg. Eisht hug eh geinnagh veih'n traie fo'n vynreayrtan. Va dagh grine geinnee mooar nish. Va paart jeh ny grineyn bane, as paart jeu doo.

“Nish, jeeagh er shoh,” dooyrt Alastair. Va ushtey veih'n cheayn echey. Ayns yn ushtey, va frauaig gorrym as frauaig jiarg. “Ta ny frauaigyn shoh jeh plastagh,” dooyrt eh. “T'ad çheet veih eaddeeyn. T'ad mynreayrtagh: cha nod sleih fakin ad gyn mynreayrtan. Agh ta ny eeastyn gee ny reddyn mynreayrtagh shoh.” Va Greer, inneen hoght bleeaney, jeeaghyn er y frauaig rish tammylt liauyr.

Eisht hug Alastair soilshey neoin er. Va'n soilshey neoin jiarg as sollys. Va kishtey trooid-hoilshagh echey, as hug eh y soilshey neoin ayns y chishtey trooid-hoilshagh. Va'n soilshey jiarg ry-akin trooid y chishtey.

Ec y jerrey, loayr Alastair mychione ny rollageyn. “Ta comaid getlagh shaghey yn Theihll y vee shoh,” dooyrt eh. “Ta'n chomaid jeant jeh rio as clagh, as t'ee getlagh dy feer tappee. 'Sy oie, foddee sleih y chomaid y akin 'syn aer.” Dinsh eh da ny paitçhyn mychione fishig quantum, as mychione sheiltynys ny conastaght, va screeuit ec Albert Einstein. “Ta fishig quantum as y chonastaght doillee,” dooyrt eh, “agh t'ad ginsh dooin cre'n aght ta'n seihll gobbraghey.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n cummey va er dagh crystal sollan?
Va dagh crystal ayns cummey kishtey veg.
Cre va ayns yn ushtey veih'n cheayn?
Va frauaig gorrym as frauaig jiarg ayns yn ushtey.
Vel ny frauaigyn mooar?
Cha nel. T'ad mynreayrtagh.
Cre ta getlagh shaghey yn Theihll?
Ta comaid getlagh shaghey yn Theihll.
Quoi screeu sheiltynys ny conastaght?
Screeu Albert Einstein sheiltynys ny conastaght.

lessons.title: Bollan bane er Laa Tinvaal
lessons.summary: On Tynwald Day Roisin's grandfather Eamon Duffy dresses her up and pins on a sprig of mugwort, the Manx plant of the day, explaining its pagan roots against evil spirits, the ancient parliament of an island that governs itself, the King's representative and the people of rank on the hill, and the beauty of the old custom.
lessons.text:
Er y vee Jerrey Souree, ta Laa Tinvaal ayn. Ta Roisin as e shennayr, Eamon Duffy, goll dys y chronk 'sy voghrey. Ta sleih coamrey ad hene dy mie er y laa shoh. Va Roisin coamrit ayns eaddagh noa bane, as hug Eamon bollan bane er e eaddagh. Ta'n bollan bane lus glass, as t'eh aase rish ny raaidyn 'sy tourey.

“Cre'n fa ta sleih cur bollan bane orroo?” dooyrt Roisin.

“Ta shen shenn chliaghtey,” dooyrt Eamon. “She cliaghtey paganagh eh. Roish my haink yn Agglish, va ny sleih paganagh. V'ad credjal dy row yn bollan bane freayll ad veih drogh spyrrydyn. Nish cha nel sleih credjal ayns y spyrryd shen, agh ta'n cliaghtey paganagh shoh foast ain.”

Ec y chronk, va ram seyraanee. Va dagh seyraanagh coamrit dy mie, as va bollan bane er ny h-eaddeeyn oc. “Shoh Tinvaal,” dooyrt Eamon. “Ta'n corys ard-whaiylagh shoh feer shenn. Ta Ellan Vannin neuchroghagh ayns ram reddyn. Ta ny leighyn ain jeant ayns yn ellan hene. She ellan neuchroghagh ee, as ta'n corys ard-whaiylagh ain ny shinney na corys ard-whaiylagh erbee elley.”

Haink çhaghter y Ree seose er y chronk. Ta'n çhaghter cummal 'syn ellan, as t'eh loayrt er son y Ree. Va sleih jeh rhenk ard marish: ny briwnyn, ny shirveishee as oltee y Choonceil. Va dagh rhenk ayns e voayl hene er y chronk.

Va Roisin jeeaghyn er ooilley. Va'n ghrian sollys er y chronk, va'n gheay sheidey, as va'n bollan bane er dagh peiagh. “Ta aalid er y laa shoh,” dooyrt ee. “Ta,” dooyrt Eamon. “Ta aalid er y chliaghtey shenn as er y lus beg glass.”

Feyshtyn:
Cre hug Eamon er eaddagh Roisin?
Hug eh bollan bane er e eaddagh.
Quoi v'er y chronk?
Va ram seyraanee er y chronk.
Vel Ellan Vannin neuchroghagh ayns ram reddyn?
Ta. Ta ny leighyn ain jeant ayns yn ellan hene.
Quoi ta loayrt er son y Ree?
Ta çhaghter y Ree loayrt er e hon.
Cre dooyrt Roisin mychione y laa?
Dooyrt ee dy vel aalid er y laa.

lessons.title: Y margey Jesarn
lessons.summary: Penny Murray shops at the Saturday market in Douglas for local food from nearby farms: two kilos of potatoes, brown bread full of fibre that is good for the gut, tea and apple drink with no alcohol; she pays with coins while an old farmer still pays by cheque, and she cooks a local supper.
lessons.text:
Dagh Jesarn, ta Penny Murray goll dys y margey ayns Doolish. Ta'n margey shoh son bee ynnydoil. Ta'n bee ooilley çheet veih eirinee faggyssagh. “Ta bee ynnydoil ny share son y seihll,” ta Penny gra. “Cha nel eh çheet er lhong ny er aer-lhong.”

Hoshiaght, ghow ee praaseyn veih eirinagh faggyssagh, Oisin. “Ta mee laccal daa kg,” dooyrt ee. Hug Oisin daa kg dy phraaseyn ayns y phoagey eck. Eisht ghow ee arran. Va arran dhone ec dooinney elley, jeant lesh frauaig mie. “Ta'n arran shoh mie son y collane,” dooyrt eh. “Ta'n frauaig mie son y collane, as t'eh freayll y collane slane.” Ghow Penny yn arran dhone.

Er y voayrd elley, va tey as jough ooyl. Va'n tey ass lossreeyn ynnydoil. Va'n jough ooyl gyn alcoal. “Cha nel alcoal ayn,” dooyrt yn ven. “Foddee ny paitçhyn eh y iu.” Ghow Penny y tey as y jough gyn alcoal.

Hie Penny dy eeck son y bee. Cha row kaart eck, agh va cooinaghyn eck ayns e poagey. Ren ee eeck lesh ny cooinaghyn. Ec y traa cheddin, haink shenn eirinagh dys Oisin. Va sheck echey. “Ta mee eeck lesh sheck,” dooyrt y shenn dooinney, “myr ren mee rieau.” Ghow Oisin y sheck. “Cha nel ram sleih eeck lesh sheck nish,” dooyrt eh rish Penny, “agh s'mie lhiam eh.”

Ec jerrey yn laa, ren Penny shibbyr. Hug ee ny praaseyn 'syn ushtey çheh, as hug ee arran er y voayrd. V'ee iu tey marish y shibbyr. Va'n shibbyr ooilley ynnydoil, veih ny eirinee faggyssagh.

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n sorçh dy vee t'ayns y margey?
Ta bee ynnydoil ayns y margey.
Cre wheesh dy phraaseyn ghow Penny?
Ghow ee daa kg dy phraaseyn.
Cre'n fa ta'n arran dhone mie?
Ta'n frauaig ayn mie son y collane.
Vel alcoal ayns y jough ooyl?
Cha nel. Cha nel alcoal ayn.
Cre'n aght ren y shenn eirinagh eeck?
Ren eh eeck lesh sheck.
Cre ren Penny ec jerrey yn laa?
Ren ee shibbyr ynnydoil.

lessons.title: Bussyn son y valley
lessons.summary: At an informal evening meeting in Castletown about buses, Tegan Brophy hears participants say the rural timetable is complicated; Cillian's report on a twinned town in France, where nobody pays for the bus and cars are not allowed in the centre, makes them ask whether the town could do the same.
lessons.text:
Ayns Balley Chashtal, va quail ayn Jecrean 'syn astyr. Va'n quail neuformoil: cha row sleih coamrit dy mie, as v'ad iu tey. Va'n quail mychione y bus. Ec shiaght er y chlag 'sy fastyr, haink feed commee dys y halley.

Va Tegan Brophy ny commee jeh'n quail. T'ee cummal ayns balley neuvoirvaljagh faggys da Balley Chashtal. “Ta'n bus anmagh dy mennick,” dooyrt ee. “Ayns ny buill neuvoirvaljagh, cha nel agh un bus 'sy voghrey as un bus 'sy fastyr. Ta'n traa-chlaare crampit, as cha nel fys ec sleih cre'n traa ta'n bus çheet.”

Dooyrt commee elley dy row y traa-chlaare crampit myrgeddin. “Ta mee laccal goll gys yn obbyr er y bus,” dooyrt eh, “agh ta'n traa-chlaare ro chrampit. Shen y fa ta mee goll ayns my ghleashtan.”

Eisht loayr Cillian. She ard-shirveish y valley eh. “Ta Balley Chashtal lannooney rish balley 'sy Rank,” dooyrt eh. “Ren ad lannooney ny baljyn 'sy vlein 1990. Hie mee dys y balley shen er y vee shoh chaie. Ayns shen, cha nel sleih eeck son y bus. Cha nel eh lowit da gleashtanyn goll ayns mean y valley. Ta'n bus çheet dy mennick, as ta'n traa-chlaare aashagh.”

“Oddagh shin shen y yannoo ayns Balley Chashtal?” dooyrt Tegan.

“Oddagh,” dooyrt Cillian. “Agh ta feme ain loayrt rish y reiltys hoshiaght. Oddagh shin gra nagh vel eh lowit da gleashtanyn goll ayns mean y valley Jesarn, son toshiaght.”

Lurg y quail, va ny commee booiagh. Va'n quail neuformoil, agh va eieyn mie ayn. Hie Tegan dys y thie er y bus nane jeig er y chlag. Va'n bus anmagh reesht.

Feyshtyn:
Cre'n traa haink ny commee dys y quail?
Haink ad ec shiaght er y chlag 'sy fastyr.
Row'n quail formoil?
Cha row. Va'n quail neuformoil.
Raad ta Tegan cummal?
T'ee cummal ayns balley neuvoirvaljagh.
Cre ta Tegan gra mychione y traa-chlaare?
T'ee gra dy vel y traa-chlaare crampit.
Vel eh lowit da gleashtanyn goll ayns mean y valley lannooney?
Cha nel. Cha nel eh lowit.

lessons.title: Poosey 'sy chabbal
lessons.summary: Fiadh Gallagher and Lachlan Cassidy marry in a small stone chapel in Laxey with flowers from the glen instead of plastic; they exchange their grandparents' silver rings and kiss, practised dancers do a stick dance outside, and Lachlan's sister Mairead studies weddings for a sociological project.
lessons.text:
Ayns Laksaa, ta cabbal beg. Ta'n cabbal shenn, as t'eh jeant jeh clagh. Jesarn shoh chaie, va poosey 'sy chabbal: ren Fiadh Gallagher as Lachlan Cassidy poosey.

Cha row Fiadh laccal reddyn jeh plastagh ec y phoosey. “Ta reddyn myr shen drogh son y seihll,” dooyrt ee. Shen y fa va blaaghyn veih'n glion 'sy chabbal. Va duillagyn çhirrym as blaaghyn ec ny sleih dy cheau er ny poosee noa.

'Sy chabbal, hug Lachlan fainney er laue Fiadh, as hug Fiadh fainney er laue Lachlan. Va ny fainnaghyn jeh argid, as v'ad shenn: va ny fainnaghyn shoh ec shennayr as ec shenn voir Fiadh. Eisht hug ad paag da'n cheilley. Va ooilley ny sleih 'sy chabbal booiagh tra honnick ad y phaag.

Lurg y phoosey, va daunsey ayn er y faiyr ry-lhiattee rish y chabbal. Haink shey daunseyryn. Va ny daunseyryn shoh cliaghtit: va'n daunse jeant oc ec ram poosaghyn. Va maidjey ayns laue dagh daunseyr. V'ad cur yn maidjey noi maidjey yn daunseyr elley, as v'ad goll mygeayrt as mygeayrt. Ta'n daunse maidjey shoh shenn 'syn ellan. Va ny daunseyryn cliaghtit cho tappee, agh cha duitt unnane jeu.

Va Mairead, shuyr Lachlan, ec y phoosey. T'ee studeyrys ec yn ollooscoill. T'ee jannoo ronsaghey sheshengoaylleeagh mychione poosaghyn. “Ta poosaghyn caghlaa,” dooyrt ee. “Ta ronsaghey sheshengoaylleeagh jeeaghyn dy vel sleih aegey laccal poosaghyn beggey, as dy vel ad smooinaghtyn er y seihll mygeayrt oc.”

Feyshtyn:
Raad ren Fiadh as Lachlan poosey?
Ren ad poosey 'sy chabbal beg ayns Laksaa.
Va reddyn jeh plastagh ec y phoosey?
Cha row. Va blaaghyn veih'n glion 'sy chabbal.
Cre va ny fainnaghyn jeant jeh?
Va ny fainnaghyn jeant jeh argid.
Cre va ayns laue dagh daunseyr?
Va maidjey ayns laue dagh daunseyr.
Cre'n ronsaghey ta Mairead jannoo?
T'ee jannoo ronsaghey sheshengoaylleeagh mychione poosaghyn.

lessons.title: Yn leion as y kayt
lessons.summary: Una Riordan, a new zoology graduate working at a zoo in England, shows a class the lion: she explains that it resembles a house cat, that both are vertebrates, finds its tracks in the mud, offers it meat and tells the children to keep back; then they gather fallen flowers and measure a sepal in centimetres.
lessons.text:
Ta Una Riordan ny keimagh noa. Ren ee studeyrys er baaghyn ec yn ollooscoill, as nish t'ee gobbraghey ec garey baaghyn ayns Sostyn. Ta ram keimee gobbraghey 'sy gharey shoh.

Jeheiney, haink rang veih scoill dys y gharey. Hug Una ad dys y leion. Va'n leion ny lhie 'sy ghrian. “T'eh soylee kayt,” dooyrt guilley beg. “T'eh,” dooyrt Una. “Ta'n leion soylee yn kayt ayns y thie: ta'n cummey cheddin oc, as t'ad cadley ram. Ta'n leion as y kayt vertebragh. Ta craue drommey ec dagh vertebragh, chammah as ec eeastyn, ushagyn as sleih.”

Eisht ren ad shooyl rish y cleigh. 'Sy laagh, va lorg cassyn. “Jeeagh,” dooyrt Una. “She lorg y leion eh. Ta'n lorg shoh mooar: t'eh ny smoo na kentimeader feed er lheead.” Va spoht doo er y chlagh faggys da'n lorg. “Ta'n spoht shoh ushtey,” dooyrt ee. “Va'n leion iu.”

Ec y traa shen, haink yn arreyder lesh feill. Va'n arreyder çhebbal feill da'n leion. “Çheb peesh feill da'n leion,” dooyrt eh rish Una. Ren Una feill y chur da'n leion er maidjey liauyr. “Cum foddey veih'n leion!” dooyrt ee rish ny paitçhyn. “Cum foddey veih'n chleigh.” Ren ny paitçhyn cummal foddey ersooyl.

Lurg shen, hie ad dys y garey blaaghyn. “Çhaggil ny blaaghyn ta er y thalloo,” dooyrt Una. Haggil ny paitçhyn ny blaaghyn va er duittym. Haggil ad feed blaa. Hug Una blaa er y voayrd. “Fo'n blaa, ta seepal glass,” dooyrt ee. “Ta'n seepal coadey yn blaa tra t'eh beg. Cre'n lhiurid t'er y seepal?” Ren ad y seepal y howse: va'n seepal daa kentimeader er lhiurid.

Feyshtyn:
Cre ren Una Riordan studeyrys?
Ren ee studeyrys er baaghyn. She keimagh ee.
Cre ta'n leion soylee?
T'eh soylee kayt.
Cre va 'sy laagh rish y cleigh?
Va lorg cassyn y leion 'sy laagh.
Cre va'n arreyder çhebbal da'n leion?
Va'n arreyder çhebbal feill da'n leion.
Cre'n lhiurid va er y seepal?
Va'n seepal daa kentimeader er lhiurid.

lessons.title: Fockleyn yn aundyr
lessons.summary: At a Manx class in Douglas, Mamadou Bah from Guinea says his Manx is still weak; the teacher Struan Mylott plays word games on the origins of nature words, shows how to tell palatal sounds apart, and tells the history of Manx ships that carried slaves from the coast of Guinea.
lessons.text:
Dagh Jeheiney, ta rang Gaelg ayns Doolish. Ta'n ynseyder, Struan Mylott, gynsaghey fockleyn mychione yn aundyr: fockleyn son lossreeyn, ushagyn as y cheayn.

Ta Mamadou Bah 'sy rang. Haink eh veih'n Ghuinea. T'eh cummal ayns Doolish rish tree bleeaney. “Ta my Ghaelg moal foast,” dooyrt eh. “Ta mee toiggal ram, agh ta my loayrt moal.” “Cha nel dty Ghaelg moal,” dooyrt Struan. “T'ee goll ny share dagh shiaghtin.”

Jiu, ren Struan gammanyn focklagh. Ayns un ghamman focklagh, va dagh studeyr shirrey bun-ocklaght fockle. “Cre'n bun-ocklaght t'ec y fockle 'bollan bane'?” dooyrt Struan. “She lus eh, as ta 'bane' çheet veih'n Ghaelg hene.” Ta bun-ocklaght ram fockleyn ayns y Yernish, er y fa dy vel y Ghaelg as y Yernish casley.

Eisht loayr Struan mychione corocklyn cleaoil. “Ayns y Ghaelg, ta corocklyn cleaoil as corocklyn elley ayn. Ta corockle cleaoil ec toshiaght y fockle 'çheer'. Ta feme ain eddyraghey ny corocklyn cleaoil veih ny corocklyn elley. My ta sleih eddyraghey ad dy mie, bee ad toiggal ny fockleyn.” Ren Mamadou eddyraghey ny corocklyn dy mie.

Ec y jerrey, dooyrt Mamadou: “Cre'n fa ta enney ec sleih yn ellan er y Ghuinea?” Dinsh Struan da mychione y shennaghys. Roish ny smoo na daa cheead blein, va lhongyn veih'n ellan goll dys oirr y Ghuinea. Va ny lhongyn shoh cur sleabyn harrish y cheayn. Va dagh sleab ec fer elley, as cha row seyrsnys echey. “She shennaghys trome eh,” dooyrt Struan. Cha dooyrt Mamadou veg rish tammylt. Eisht dooyrt eh, “Ta feme ain y shennaghys shoh y ynsaghey, chammah as ny fockleyn.”

Feyshtyn:
Raad haink Mamadou Bah veih?
Haink eh veih'n Ghuinea.
Vel e Ghaelg moal?
Ta Mamadou gra dy vel e Ghaelg moal, agh t'ee goll ny share.
Cre ren Struan jiu?
Ren eh gammanyn focklagh.
Raad ta corockle cleaoil ayns 'çheer'?
Ta corockle cleaoil ec toshiaght y fockle.
Cre va ny lhongyn cur harrish y cheayn?
V'ad cur sleabyn harrish y cheayn.
